changelog:
v2.6.0 — CYBER CLEANER SUITE:

🧹 Junk Cleaner — one deep scan sweeps camera thumbnails, app caches, stale temp/log files, messenger caches, Android/data caches and empty folders; shows reclaimable size and frees it with Clean All. Grant All-Files access once for a full sweep.

⚡ Memory Booster — live RAM report with a gradient bar; Boost kills background processes and reports the freed MB.

🦠 Antivirus — an honest permission-risk scanner: scores every installed app on dangerous permission combos (SMS spies, call-log thieves, hidden APK installers, overlay attacks), flags sideloaded apps, one-tap uninstall shortcut for real threats.

❄️ App Freezer — Tecno/Infinix-style app suspension. Frozen apps can't start, run, or drain RAM/battery, and nothing is uninstalled. Two power paths: Device Owner (one-time ADB command, shown in-app) or Shizuku. Unfreeze All safety button included.

Same signing cert — updates in place over v2.5.2.
